scenes.narration: Can you guess the lowest salary an NFL player can earn in 2026?
885,000 dollars. That's the league minimum for a rookie.
It's paid in 18 equal weekly checks across the regular season.
So even the lowest-paid player gets about 49 thousand dollars a week.
The minimum climbs with experience. Players with seven or more seasons get at least 1.3 million.
And each team can spend up to 301.2 million dollars on players this year.
